render.order: For frame i draw every layer's frame i in `layers` order at the same spot, after swapping the recolor keys (exact RGB). Side frames face LEFT: mirror the whole composite for right.
render.outline: After `hat` and before `fx`, add a 1-px outline: every transparent pixel with an opaque 4-neighbour becomes outline[bodyType key]. fx strips carry their own outline.
render.hats: When a hat is worn use hair_front_flat (and hair_back_flat when present) instead of hair_front/hair_back.
render.frameOffset: Add frameOffset[body][i] to y for every layer (and the outline) of that body (the spirit floats).
render.missing: A layer whose key is missing from `files` is empty for that option.

highfive.note: Two avatars facing each other, anchors this many px apart.
